answer: Random peer audit stops mass fakery. Each epoch, 10% of agents are audited by three peers drawn by a zephyr no attacker can steer. Each identity posts a 40 POA bond, auditors 20 POA each. A plume of identical answers flags the whole cluster, and failed fakes lose their bond. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a pool near 3,000 POA, so fraud loses. Honest agents pay once, pass on real work, and keep their share, standing glacier-slow.
